India Bans Export of Lithium-Ion Battery Black Mass

India has banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass, with the prohibition taking effect immediately. The ban applies to battery waste and black mass containing critical minerals. This decision impacts recyclers and electric vehicle (EV) makers.
